elements.content: Put Your Customer Service on Autopilot with Acme
Clear your inbox in record time. Acme uses advanced AI to handle repetitive queries across all channels, freeing your team to focus on what truly matters.
TRUSTED BY SUPPORT TEAMS THAT MOVE FAST
Every customer conversation, finally in one place.
Email, chat and social conversations flow into one shared workspace. Acme keeps context, ownership and priority visible without adding more admin.
Intent, sentiment and customer history help Acme route each conversation before anyone touches it.
Let Acme, Inc. handle the repetitive work.
Build rules once, then let conversations move forward automatically while your team focuses on the moments that actually need a human.
From “where is my order?” to resolved — automatically.
Trigger actions from intent, customer tier, language, sentiment or any property in your stack.
Acme drafts replies using your knowledge base, policies and the full customer history — ready for a quick human check.
“I’ve checked your order — it’s arriving tomorrow before 6 PM.”
Support that scales without feeling scaled.
Faster response times are useful. Better customer experiences are the point.
Give your support team their time back.
See how Acme, Inc. can fit your inbox, workflows and customer journey in a 20-minute walkthrough.
Customer service automation that gives teams more time for the conversations that matter.
